IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##TMP_PDS_OPEN_CASES') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##TMP_PDS_OPEN_CASES
CREATE TABLE ##TMP_PDS_OPEN_CASES(
	[CASE_ID] [varchar](250) NULL,
	[CASE_STATUS] [varchar](250) NULL
)

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_ID AS CASE_ID,CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_STATUS AS CASE_STATUS FROM PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY WHERE CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_STATUS = 'Open'

USE CAREADVANCE_DM  DECLARE @CURRENT_DATE_KEY INT  SELECT @CURRENT_DATE_KEY = DATE_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()))  DECLARE @CURRENT_TIME_KEY INT  SELECT @CURRENT_TIME_KEY = TIME_KEY  FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,GETDATE()))  SELECT DC.CASE_ID,DCS.STATUS_DESC AS CASE_STATUS FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE DC 	INNER JOIN ##TMP_PDS_OPEN_CASES T ON DC.CASE_ID COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AI = T.CASE_ID 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_CASE FC ON FC.CASE_KEY = DC.CASE_KEY 		AND FC.GROUP_CK = DC.GROUP_CK 		AND (FC.EFF_DATE < @CURRENT_DATE_KEY OR (FC.EFF_DATE = @CURRENT_DATE_KEY AND FC.EFF_TIME < @CURRENT_TIME_KEY)) 		AND (FC.TERM_DATE > @CURRENT_DATE_KEY OR (FC.TERM_DATE = @CURRENT_DATE_KEY AND FC.TERM_TIME > @CURRENT_TIME_KEY)) 	INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS DCS ON FC.STATUS_ID = DCS.STATUS_ID WHERE DCS.STATUS_DESC <> 'Open'

UPDATE H
SET CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_STATUS = T.CASE_STATUS,CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_UPDATE_DATE = GETDATE()
FROM PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY H
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_335_UPDATES_STAGING T ON H.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_ID = T.CASE_ID
